content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Associate / Project Consultant posts at NIT Delhi is scheduled for 03 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Project Associate / Project Consultant posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 8 vacancies announced by NIT Delhi for the Project Associate / Project Consultant positions. These vacancies are distributed across various specializations and roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Project Associate (Civil) post?
faq.answer: For the Project Associate (Civil) post, candidates need to have a B.Tech. in Civil Engineering with at least 2 years of experience, or a Diploma in Civil Engineering with at least 4 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the posts announced by NIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts, including Project Associate and Project Consultant, is 65 years. There is no mention of age relaxation for specific categories in the provided data.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Project Consultant (Civil) position?
faq.answer: The Project Consultant (Civil) position offers a monthly salary of Rs. 55,000/-. This is the highest salary offered among the announced positions.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of these documents (including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates), and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these contractual posts at NIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contractual positions at NIT Delhi is based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be assessed based on their qualifications and experience during the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview for NIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly state the venue address for the walk-in interview. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification PDF for the exact venue details and reporting time.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the announced positions at NIT Delhi?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Associate / Project Consultant positions at NIT Delhi is contractual. This means the employment will be for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.
